verdict.rationale: Carta documents a REST API with OAuth 2.0, a playground environment, Postman access, and MCP plugins, but nothing in the evidence mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. Raw API endpoints and Postman collections are building blocks or user-side tooling, not official SDKs, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
